conceptZh: 浣熊花生抱著高高的消防泡棉零件敬禮失手，再助跑滑肚撞倒整排零件，翻滾堆成「消」，最後拉著消防車得意敬禮。
object: Ten saturated blue foam stroke pieces carried in a precarious stack, plus one small original toy fire engine.
morph: A belly-slide bowling impact tumbles ten foam pieces into the exact strokes of 消: three separate water-radical strokes on the left and a correctly proportioned 肖 on the right.
creativeAngle: 花生太早敬禮，把搬運任務變成滑肚保齡球；撞擊直接排出三點水與肖，最後由真正入鏡的消防車呼應詞語，讓消防意象與字形同時清楚。
promptEn:
Create an 8-second stylized 3D cartoon with one continuous, fixed overhead view of a pale cream, slippery floor. Peanut is an original cartoon raccoon assistant: round cheeks, an enormous striped tail, earnest eyebrows, and comically misplaced confidence. Use warm, bright colors, soft shadows and gentle squash-and-stretch. His goal is to deliver a towering stack of ten saturated cobalt-blue foam stroke pieces to the center of the floor.

0.0–1.4 seconds: Peanut scurries in carrying the wobbling stack, eyes fixed on his delivery spot. The off-screen voice says the first “消” as he starts lowering the pieces. He prematurely salutes with one paw; the stack tips off his other paw and bounces into a single bowling-pin row across his path. His empty-handed salute freezes, then his ears spring up with an idea.

1.4–3.1 seconds: Peanut retreats several quick steps for a visibly long run-up, charges left to right, then dives belly-first. His tail sticks straight up like a sail as he skids toward the whole row, paws stretched forward and grin growing wider. Keep the slide and its destination visible together.

3.1–5.0 seconds: One soft, spectacular BONK! The row topples in a traveling wave; blue pieces tumble, spin and bump one another into a flat, neatly arranged 消. Peanut rebounds gently into the lower margin with a dizzy grin. The second spoken “消” lands at 4.7 seconds, exactly as the last piece seats. By 5.0 seconds the complete glyph is locked and motionless. Engineer every piece to its destination: three distinct 氵 strokes on the left; on the right, 肖 with its correct small upper strokes and clear 月 below, including both inner horizontal bars. Preserve the hooked and connected stroke shapes; no extra blue fragments.

5.0–8.0 seconds: Hold the centered, uncropped 消 perfectly still at approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. At 5.5 seconds a tiny original red toy fire engine rolls into the lower margin, pulled by Peanut, precisely as the voice says “消防車.” Its ladder, hose reel and wheels make it immediately recognizable. Beside it, Peanut strikes a triumphant bowling pose, salutes, and gives one happy tail wiggle, entirely clear of the glyph.

Audio: warm, friendly off-screen Taiwanese Mandarin, reading exactly “消、消、消防車” (ㄒㄧㄠ、ㄒㄧㄠ、ㄒㄧㄠ ㄈㄤˊ ㄔㄜ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones and short pauses. Finish after the word. Soft slide and foam-bonk sounds sit beneath the voice. The single glyph 消 is the only on-screen text; keep the background uncluttered and the cast entirely animated.
